models_evaluated: cardiac decompensation prediction algorithm (CIED-based) shown in high-fidelity smartphone app prototype

links.outcome: Patient comprehension of predictive algorithm output, threshold, and contributing sensors in prototype usability testing
links.effect: Comprehension of output 80% to 85%; threshold comprehension 60% to 85%; comprehension of contributing CIED sensors 63% to 93% (n=20).
links.quote: Comprehension of the algorithm output was high across conditions (80% to 85%), but comprehension of the algorithm's threshold varied (60% to 85%), as did comprehension of the CIED sensors contributing to the algorithm (63% to 93%).

unlisted_practices: Design framework for presenting machine learning predictions to patients through a smartphone app, with return of personal health data

screen.reason: Evaluates a design framework and smartphone prototype for safely and effectively communicating machine learning risk predictions to patients, measuring patient comprehension and intended actions.
